calendar.summary: Interactive calendar with day, week, month, and agenda views, time-grid event placement, drag-and-drop rescheduling, multi-event recurrence, and safe event drafting.
primaryRequirements: Preserve time-grid geometry and interaction controller contract on Windows desktop.
Preserve Android touch agenda view and date-following scroll behavior separately.
Safe draft retention: never discard uncommitted event/session text on focus change.
Accurate recurrence calculation (leap years, month-end date clamping, exceptions).
Readability at 320 dp viewport and 150% font scale without clipped times.
architectureBoundaries: Calendar views observe AppController and call EventRepository through LifeRepository.
Pure recurrence math in lib/domain/recurrence.dart must remain pure with zero UI imports.
All event mutations require stable UUIDs and UTC timestamps in SQLite.
Never auto-complete or silently reschedule events or tasks.
designSystemTokens: Batch 1 presentation rules (date presentation, action labels, editor layout).
AppLayout breakpoints (desktop vs compact), AppSpacing, AppModalShell for dialogs.
TodorbitThemeTokens for event category chips and contrast in both light and dark themes.
historicalInvariants: Time-grid zoom and scroll must not cause NaN or infinite layout bounds.
Android date agenda must follow the selected calendar date without lag or jump.
Draft editor must retain typed title/notes if dialog loses focus or device rotates.

calendar-ui.summary: Calendar presentation components, card styling, color contrast, and event editor layout.
primaryRequirements: Accessible color contrast for all event cards across light and dark themes.
Event editor layout responsive to desktop breakpoint and mobile keyboard clearance.
Clear visual distinction between fixed events, planned sessions, and task deadlines.
architectureBoundaries: Calendar presentation components must not bypass EventRepository for mutations.
Shared editors must adapt between modal dialogs (Windows) and bottom sheets / full screen (Android).
designSystemTokens: Fluent-inspired calendar styling and high-contrast event chips.
AppSpacing, AppModalShell, AppTheme tokens for event cards.
historicalInvariants: Event editor fields must not overflow when on-screen keyboard appears on Android.
Card title text must remain readable under custom category colors.

sync.summary: Incremental Google Drive synchronization with journal-based delta exchanges, CAS concurrency tokens, tombstone retention, device pairing, and optional end-to-end encryption.
primaryRequirements: Zero data loss: never overwrite or delete local data on conflict or failure.
Offline-first: all local modifications commit immediately to SQLite and sync journal.
CAS (Compare-And-Swap) token concurrency for atomic remote generation updates.
Crash resilience: transactional rollback if network or app terminates during batch apply.
Preserve distinction between Standard Sync and optional Encrypted Sync.
architectureBoundaries: Local writes go through LifeRepository parts; Sync reads journal and writes applied deltas.
Sync exchange models are versioned and separate from Drift SQLite entity classes.
Zero unreviewed cloud providers: Google Drive application data folder is the sole remote.
Encryption keys remain local and are never logged or exported in plain text.
designSystemTokens: SyncStatusButton with distinct states: idle, in-progress, offline, warning, conflict.
AppModalShell for conflict resolution and encryption setup dialogs.
historicalInvariants: CAS generation mismatch must abort push and trigger pull to prevent overwrite.
Deleted items must produce tombstones so remote devices do not resurrect them.
Interrupted batch apply must safely roll back SQLite transaction leaving state clean.

task-lists.summary: Task list views, custom filters, saved views, group headers, drag reordering, and responsive layout.
primaryRequirements: Fast rendering of large task collections with lazy list view projection.
Preserve task grouping, completed section collapse, and sort order.
Adhere to Batch 2 task-list presentation rules (clearance, row actions, hover states).
architectureBoundaries: Presentation renders TaskListProjection derived from AppController state.
Row actions trigger AppController methods; row never writes to LifeRepository directly.
designSystemTokens: AppTaskRow component, AppSpacing.rowGap, priority badges, completion checkbox.
Batch 2 presentation rules: grouping, visual hierarchy, mobile swipe actions.
historicalInvariants: Completed tasks section must not shift row layout unexpectedly.
Checkboxes must have at least 44x44 touch target clearance on mobile devices.

tasks.summary: Task CRUD, task detail editor, subtasks/checklists, priority, recurrence, deadlines, and planned sessions.
primaryRequirements: Safe multi-field editing with draft preservation.
Strict separation between planned dates, deadlines, sessions, actual work, and fixed events.
Revision counter tokens to detect and prevent concurrency collisions.
architectureBoundaries: All task writes go through LifeRepository parts in transactions.
Never auto-complete or silently reschedule tasks.
designSystemTokens: Batch 1 presentation rules (task dates, editor layout, action labels).
AppSpacing, AppModalShell, TodorbitThemeTokens.
historicalInvariants: Concurrent edits on different devices or tabs must be resolved via revision counter.
Task editor must not drop checklist progress on rapid close.

database.summary: Local SQLite database management via Drift, forward schema migrations, integrity validation, and crash-safe transactions.
primaryRequirements: Forward-only migrations; never drop or reset data as an error fallback.
All schema changes increment schemaVersion and add explicit migration step-up.
Native Windows and Android companion processes must never run migrations.
architectureBoundaries: Drift database layer is wrapped by LifeRepository.
Foreign keys and WAL mode enabled.
Transactions required for all multi-record operations.
historicalInvariants: Schema upgrade from 27 -> 28 -> 29 must retain all existing tasks, events, and sync journals.
Database corruption fallback must preserve backup before any recovery attempt.

alarms.summary: Cross-platform alarm scheduling, reminders, notifications, and background Doze wakeups.
primaryRequirements: Reliable alarm delivery across Windows and Android.
Support exact alarms and battery optimization handling on modern Android versions.
Alarm settings UI with sound, vibration, and advance warning configuration.
architectureBoundaries: Dart computes AlarmPlan; native OS handles actual background alarm dispatch.
Device-specific alarm configuration stored in AlarmDeviceStore.
designSystemTokens: AlarmField widget, AppModalShell, Fluent toggle controls.
historicalInvariants: Alarms must survive device reboots via persistent alarm store and boot receiver.

task-timers.summary: Focus sessions, Pomodoro timers, active session management, and productivity time tracking.
primaryRequirements: Focus timer ticks stay local to widget; never write per-second updates to SQLite.
Completed focus sessions persist with accurate UTC start and end times.
Compact floating/docked timer presentation on desktop and mobile.
architectureBoundaries: AppController coordinates active FocusSession state in memory.
TimeRepository writes final session records to SQLite.
designSystemTokens: Timer display typography, start/pause/stop button states, progress ring.
AppLayout compact breakpoints.
historicalInvariants: Session pause/resume must accurately account for elapsed time without drifting.

habits.summary: Habit tracking, recurrence schedules, streak calculations, check-in history, and performance statistics.
primaryRequirements: Daily and weekly habit recurrence tracking.
Streak calculation honoring custom recurrence days.
Habit check-in date and progress readable at 320 dp and 150% text scale.
architectureBoundaries: Habit calculations in lib/domain/habits.dart with zero UI imports.
Habit check-ins saved to SQLite through LifeRepository.
designSystemTokens: Habit progress rings, streak counters, AppSpacing, AppModalShell.
historicalInvariants: Streak calculation must handle timezones without skipping valid check-ins.

goals.summary: Long-term goal setting, milestone tracking, linked tasks, and target date projections.
primaryRequirements: Goal progress tracking calculated from linked tasks or manual milestone check-ins.
Responsive layout for goal editor at compact viewport widths.
architectureBoundaries: Goal entity management through GoalRepository.
Domain calculations in lib/domain/goals.dart.
designSystemTokens: Milestone progress bars, target date tags, AppModalShell.
historicalInvariants: Completed goals must retain historical milestone data when viewed in archive.

windows-updates.summary: Windows desktop application updates, resumable downloads, hash verification, and updater helper launch.
primaryRequirements: Resumable byte-range HTTP download with checksum validation.
Non-blocking background download with progress presentation.
Clean handoff to update-helper.ps1 with process termination and replacement.
architectureBoundaries: Update service runs asynchronously without blocking main thread.
External helper process handles file replacement after Flutter app exit.
designSystemTokens: Download progress bar, version comparison card, download size badge.
historicalInvariants: Corrupted or partially downloaded update binaries must be discarded and re-downloaded.

android-updates.summary: Android application update checking, GitHub release APK download, signature check, and package installer intent.
primaryRequirements: Resumable download of GitHub release APK.
Package installer intent trigger on Android GitHub build flavor; Play Store redirect on Play flavor.
architectureBoundaries: Platform flavor separation (GitHub APK installer vs Google Play Store flow).
designSystemTokens: Mobile update card, progress percentage, release notes viewer.
historicalInvariants: Download resume must verify server Accept-Ranges header before issuing Range requests.

widgets.summary: Desktop Windows native companion widget and Android home screen widgets.
primaryRequirements: Narrow SQLite read/write companion that never runs schema migrations.
IPC communication between main app and companion widget.
Lightweight resource usage and low memory footprint.
architectureBoundaries: Companion process connects to SQLite with read-only or narrow transaction scope.
Companion must never alter database schema or run Drift migrations.
designSystemTokens: Synchronized theme tokens between Flutter and native C# widget renderers.
historicalInvariants: Main app restart must not leave orphan widget processes hanging.
Widget configuration changes in main app must synchronize immediately to native host.

mobile.summary: Android responsive layouts, navigation bars, bottom sheets, mobile-specific touch interactions.
primaryRequirements: 320 dp minimum width support without clipping or horizontal overflow.
150% font scaling readability across all screens and forms.
Preserve parity with Windows desktop features.
architectureBoundaries: Mobile features reuse shared AppController and repositories; no separate mobile data layer.
designSystemTokens: Bottom navigation bar, mobile floating action button, 44x44 dp minimum touch targets.
AppSpacing, AppModalShell adapted as bottom sheet.
historicalInvariants: Back button / gesture must dismiss bottom sheet or dialog without exiting app unexpectedly.
Keyboard opening must not push primary action buttons offscreen.

drive.summary: Google Drive full snapshot backup/restore, archive export/import, and OAuth authentication.
primaryRequirements: Atomic full snapshot backup creation and restore.
Strict separation from incremental Google Drive Sync.
Never overwrite or delete local data as a fallback.
architectureBoundaries: Full database export to encrypted/unencrypted snapshot zip archive.
Restore creates a safety backup of existing local state before applying snapshot.
designSystemTokens: Backup history list, restore confirmation modal, Google account profile header.
historicalInvariants: Restore operation must create pre-restore snapshot before modifying current SQLite database.

settings.summary: Application preferences, profile transfer, appearance settings, and isolation.
primaryRequirements: Profile JSON stores device-specific settings without polluting shared database.
Portable settings export and import.
Strict profile isolation ensuring test executions never touch production profile.
architectureBoundaries: Preferences stored in JSON files in active profile directory.
SettingsTransfer coordinates bundle packaging.
designSystemTokens: SettingsSection component, Fluent toggle switches, slider controls.
historicalInvariants: Switching profiles must cleanly release SQLite file locks.

settings-ui.summary: Settings hub modal dialog, navigation sidebar, sub-pages, and responsive settings presentation.
primaryRequirements: Fluent navigation sidebar with icon + label layout.
Settings sub-page responsive to compact widths.
architectureBoundaries: Presentation delegates actions to AppController and respective service controllers.
designSystemTokens: SettingsSection, AppModalShell, Fluent styled navigation list.
historicalInvariants: Dialog close must safely flush dirty preference drafts.

notifications.summary: Android system notifications and reminder refresh jobs.
primaryRequirements: Timely local notification dispatch.
Notification channel management and icon assets.
architectureBoundaries: Dart projection feeds native Android notification manager.
historicalInvariants: Notification clicks must route to correct task or event without crashing.

reports.summary: Productivity reports, completed tasks statistics, time tracking summaries, and charts.
primaryRequirements: Accurate date range filtering and aggregation.
Clear visual charts and exportable summary data.
architectureBoundaries: Reports logic aggregates data from TaskRepository, EventRepository, and TimeRepository.
designSystemTokens: Data charts, summary stat cards, AppSpacing.
historicalInvariants: Reports calculation must handle empty periods gracefully without division by zero.

templates.summary: Task templates, checklist templates, and recurring workflow instantiation.
primaryRequirements: Save task structure as reusable template.
Instantiate new tasks with calculated relative due dates from template.
architectureBoundaries: Templates stored in dedicated SQLite tables; instantiation creates new independent task records.
designSystemTokens: Template card, variable placeholders, AppModalShell.
historicalInvariants: Template instantiation must generate unique UUIDs for all child checklist items.

scheduling.summary: Smart rescheduling, auto-scheduling engine, and task slot placement.
primaryRequirements: Conflict-free automatic task scheduling into open calendar slots.
Respect task deadlines, priority, and estimated duration.
architectureBoundaries: Pure scheduling algorithm in lib/domain/scheduling_engine.dart.
AppController applies suggested schedule upon user confirmation.
designSystemTokens: Slot preview card, conflict indicators, AppModalShell.
historicalInvariants: Smart rescheduling must never move fixed calendar events.

trash.summary: Deleted tasks/events recovery bin, restoration, and permanent purge.
primaryRequirements: Soft-deleted item retention.
Restore items with original relationships intact.
Permanent deletion cleanup.
architectureBoundaries: Soft deletion updates deleted_at timestamp in SQLite.
Purge removes records and journals deletion tombstones for Sync.
designSystemTokens: Trash item list, restore action button, permanent delete warning dialog.
historicalInvariants: Restoring a task with a deleted parent checklist must safely reattach or make root.

time-tracking.summary: Focus timers (stopwatch, countdown, Pomodoro), session logging, and time tracking summaries linked to tasks.
primaryRequirements: Keep timer ticks local to timer widgets without global workspace rebuilds.
Derive elapsed durations monotonically from UTC timestamps.
Persist completed/interrupted focus sessions accurately via TimeRepository.
architectureBoundaries: Timer ticks remain local to timer widgets; persistence routes through TimeRepository.
designSystemTokens: Focus clock state tokens and accessible timer controls.
historicalInvariants: Starting a timer multiple times must never spawn parallel ticking loops.
